name: Dwarven District
summary: In Stormwind's northern quarter, Dwarven craftsmen keep their furnaces and workshops at work. The Deeprun Tram links their home to Ironforge.

sections.title: A Home Away from Khaz Modan
sections.body:
Dwarven artisans, smiths, and engineers make their home in Stormwind's northern quarter. Its heavy stonework, smelting works, and craft shops recall Ironforge. At Potts' Plates, craftspeople from Khaz Modan find familiar company.

On the district's eastern side, an open, arched tunnel leads to the Stormwind station of the Deeprun Tram. The tram links the human capital directly to Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is there a dwarven enclave in Stormwind?
aliases: why is it called dwarven district
faq.answer: No chronicle records how the dwarven enclave began. Today, its smiths, miners, and engineers fill the forges and workshops, while the Deeprun Tram links the quarter directly to Ironforge.

faq.q: How do you get to Ironforge from here?
faq.answer: On the district's eastern side, an open, arched tunnel leads to the Deeprun Tram station. The underground route carries travelers between Stormwind and Ironforge within minutes.

faq.q: What professions are trained in the Dwarven District?
faq.answer: Mining, blacksmithing, and engineering are taught in the Dwarven District. Heavy forges, anvils, and dedicated trainers support all three crafts.

faq.q: Where can hunters train in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's hunters make their headquarters at the Hunter's Guild in the Dwarven District, alongside dwarven marksmen and trade supplies.

angles.text: As a dwarf far from Khaz Modan, you can find familiar comfort in the roar of working blast furnaces and a quick passage back to Ironforge.
As a blacksmith, you can use Stormwind's capable smithing facilities, with expansive smelting forges, sturdy anvils, and veteran instructors.
